runner_source:
# Read-only characterization against the accepted release; no runtime acceptance.
require 'json';require 'digest';require 'fileutils';require 'open3'
abort 'Expected ACCEPTED_PROBE ACCEPTED_BINARY NEW_OUTPUT_DIR' unless ARGV.size == 3
probe, binary, out = ARGV.map { |p| File.expand_path(p) }
[probe, binary].each { |p| raise 'Missing executable ' + p unless File.executable?(p) }
raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out);FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
r={status:'running',runner_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,probe_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(probe).hexdigest,binary_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(binary).hexdigest,rows:[],semantics:[],sources:{}}
save=->{File.write(out+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 %w[int float bool null mixed].product([2,128,2048],%w[once fresh]).each do |kind,width,snapshot|
  dir=out+"/#{kind}-#{width}-#{snapshot}";FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
  expr={'int'=>'n','float'=>'n + 0.5','bool'=>'n % 2 == 0','null'=>'null'}[kind]
  body=expr ? "state[0] = #{expr}" : 'if n % 4 == 0 { state[0] = n } else if n % 4 == 1 { state[0] = n + 0.5 } else if n % 4 == 2 { state[0] = true } else { state[0] = null }'
  mod="mut state := {\"0\": 0}\nmut k := 1\nwhile k < #{width} { state[k] = k k += 1 }\nexport func snapshot() { return state }\nexport func edit(n) { #{body}\nreturn state[0] }\n"
  File.write(dir+'/owner.kujo',mod);r[:sources][Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(mod)]=mod
  [16,32].each do |calls|
   expected_body=expr ? "return #{expr}" : 'if n % 4 == 0 { return n } else if n % 4 == 1 { return n + 0.5 } else if n % 4 == 2 { return true } else { return null }'
   saved=snapshot=='fresh' ? 'let saved := snapshot() let old := saved[0]' : ''
   check=snapshot=='fresh' ? 'assert_equal(saved[0], old)' : ''
   source="from owner import edit, snapshot\nfunc expected(n) { #{expected_body} }\nlet original := snapshot()\nmut i := 1\nwhile i <= #{calls} { #{saved}\nassert_equal(edit(i), expected(i))\n#{check}\ni += 1 }\nassert_equal(original[0], 0)\nassert_equal(original[1], 1)\nassert_equal(snapshot()[0], expected(#{calls}))\nassert_equal(snapshot()[1], 1)\nprint(\"SCALAR DICTIONARY PASS\")\n"
   path=dir+"/calls-#{calls}.kujo";File.write(path,source);r[:sources][Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(source)]=source
   meta={kind:kind,width:width,snapshot:snapshot,calls:calls,module_sha256:Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(mod),source_sha256:Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(source)}
   %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
    stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(probe,mode,path);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR DICTIONARY PASS\n"
    counts=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise stderr unless counts
    r[:rows]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,requests:counts[1].to_i,bytes:counts[2].to_i);save.call
   end
   %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
    args=[binary,'run',path,'--untrusted'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
    stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR DICTIONARY PASS\n"
    r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,exit:0);save.call
   end
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==120&&r[:semantics].size==180
 r[:deltas]=r[:rows].group_by{|x|x.values_at(:kind,:width,:snapshot,:mode)}.map do |key,rows|
  a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x[:calls]};{kind:key[0],width:key[1],snapshot:key[2],mode:key[3],requests:(b[:requests]-a[:requests])/16.0,bytes:(b[:bytes]-a[:bytes])/16.0}
 end
 r[:status]='measured';save.call;puts 'Measured scalar dictionary gap:120 allocations /180 semantics'
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end
verification_source:
require 'json';require 'digest'
d=File.expand_path(__dir__);r=JSON.parse(File.read(d+'/dictionary-scalar-canonical/report.json'))
raise 'Incomplete' unless r['status']=='measured'
base=File.expand_path('../capture-key-view-v2-2026-10-27',d)
raise 'Probe identity' unless r['probe_sha256']==Digest::SHA256.file(base+'/task-allocation-probe').hexdigest
raise 'Binary identity' unless r['binary_sha256']==Digest::SHA256.file(base+'/candidate-kujo').hexdigest
raise 'Runner identity' unless r['runner_sha256']==Digest::SHA256.file('benchmarks/langarena/probes/dictionary-scalar-isolation.rb').hexdigest
r['sources'].each{|h,s|raise 'Source digest' unless Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(s)==h}
f=%w[int float bool null mixed].product([2,128,2048],%w[once fresh],[16,32]);keys=%w[kind width snapshot calls mode]
raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==f.flat_map{|x|%w[vm jit].map{|m|x+[m]}}.sort
raise 'Semantic coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==f.flat_map{|x|%w[vm interpreter jit].map{|m|x+[m]}}.sort
(r['rows']+r['semantics']).each do |x|
 folder=d+"/dictionary-scalar-canonical/#{x['kind']}-#{x['width']}-#{x['snapshot']}"
 raise 'Fixture drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(folder+"/calls-#{x['calls']}.kujo").hexdigest==x['source_sha256']&&Digest::SHA256.file(folder+'/owner.kujo').hexdigest==x['module_sha256']
 raise 'Semantic failure' if x.key?('exit')&&x['exit']!=0
end
computed=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('kind','width','snapshot','mode')}.map do |key,rows|
 a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']};{'kind'=>key[0],'width'=>key[1],'snapshot'=>key[2],'mode'=>key[3],'requests'=>(b['requests']-a['requests'])/16.0,'bytes'=>(b['bytes']-a['bytes'])/16.0}
end
raise 'Delta mismatch' unless r['deltas']==computed
raise 'Runtime disagreement' unless computed.group_by{|x|x.values_at('kind','width','snapshot')}.all?{|_,a|a.map{|x|x.values_at('requests','bytes')}.uniq.size==1}
File.write(d+'/dictionary-scalar-canonical/verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate({status:'verified_baseline_only',allocations:120,semantics:180,report_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(d+'/dictionary-scalar-canonical/report.json').hexdigest})+"\n")
puts 'Verified identity, exact matrix, fixture hashes and scalar dictionary deltas'
